400

A successful 200 response returns an Introspection object with information about the
token.
base_url/api/v2/auth/introspect
curl --request GET \
--url base_url/api/v2/auth/introspect \
--header 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_BEARER_TOKEN'
$
Example introspection response
IntrospectionV2 object schema
Name
Type
Description
uuid
string
The UUID of the Events Reporting integration.
issued_at
string
The date and time the token was issued. Uses the
RFC 3339 standard.
features
array of
strings
A list of event features the integration has access
to. Possible values are one or more of:
auditevents
itemusages
signinattempts
account_uuid
string
The UUID of the account where the bearer token
was issued.
